# Task: a newsletter issue

Write the Doefin newsletter issue for the difficulty adjustment of [date], at block [height].

- Difficulty now: [value]T ([+/-x.xx]%), source: [source, fetched date]
- Where the epoch stands: [percent done, expected date of the next adjustment]
- One thing worth reading: [title and link]
- Doefin markets and trading activity: [what moved, with dated figures]
- Anything else that happened: [optional]

Shape: a factual subject line under 50 characters that carries the news, then a preview line. Lead with the news and why it matters, with the qualifiers ("about 5.6% less expected BTC production at the same hashrate, all else equal"). Then short items on difficulty markets, trading activity and network hashrate, each with its source and dated estimates. Add risk context wherever positions come up. Do not promise a cadence. Sign it Doefin. End with the sources and the disclaimer.

Give me the subject, preview, body, then anything Matteo must review (financial examples, performance claims, new product claims).
